status: Conformance vectors for the informational Person Signature v0 (spec/person-signature-v0.md). Every key is a test key derived from a public seed, and the relying party and origins are example names; never use one for anything else.

test_keys.note: TEST-ONLY. Each Ed25519 private key is the 32-byte seed SHA-256(seed_label). Each P-256 private scalar is int(SHA-256(seed_label)) mod (n - 1) + 1.

person-es256.seed_label: person-signature-v0 vectors: the person's ES256 credential

person-ed25519.seed_label: person-signature-v0 vectors: the person's Ed25519 credential

other-es256.seed_label: person-signature-v0 vectors: another ES256 credential, not the person's

record-signer.seed_label: person-signature-v0 vectors: the key that signed the record
